name: Tax Information 8
definition: Details about tax paid, or to be paid, to the government in accordance with the law, including pre-defined parameters such as thresholds and type of account.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Party on the credit side of the transaction to which the tax applies.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Party on the debit side of the transaction to which the tax applies.

AdministrationZone.name: Administration Zone
AdministrationZone.definition: Territorial part of a country to which the tax payment is related.

ReferenceNumber.name: Reference Number
ReferenceNumber.definition: Tax reference information that is specific to a taxing agency.

Method.name: Method
Method.definition: Method used to indicate the underlying business or how the tax is paid.

TotalTaxableBaseAmount.name: Total Taxable Base Amount
TotalTaxableBaseAmount.definition: Total amount of money on which the tax is based.

TotalTaxAmount.name: Total Tax Amount
TotalTaxAmount.definition: Total amount of money as result of the calculation of the tax.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date by which tax is due.

SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Sequential number of the tax report.
